text:
mari: Uploaded venator13b q4 weights to s3://redwood-models/venator/venator13b/q4 — heads up tokenizer has a newline mapping quirk, please don't finalize catalog entry yet. Can someone run a light perf sweep (24-token prompt, 512 context) across batch sizes?
jason: on it. I'll launch on a dedicated pool. which batch sizes are highest priority? 1,4,8?
lynn: prefer [1,2,4,8,16] so we can see knee. Measure p95 latency, mean throughput (tokens/s), and GPU util. Use the bench script: `scripts/bench_serving.py --model venator13b --seq 512 --batch N --iters 200`
sudeep: tokenizer note: newline ("\n") is token id 5021 in this vocab (not standard), so prefix caching + byte-level assumptions might break some dedupe heuristics. Also we saw KV cache growth when chunking >2048 on this model.
mari: thanks @jason @lynn — also config note: set pad_to_multiple_of: 8 in manifest or some optimized kernels throw misaligned loads. Snippet to use for local smoke:
```
model_config:
  dtype: q4
  pad_to_multiple_of: 8
  kv_cache: true
  chunk_size: 2048
```
bench-bot: RUN_COMPLETE venator13b batch=1 seq=512 p95=48ms throughput=210 tokens/s (avg gpu_util=46%) — logs: https://logs.internal/venator/2764301123/run1
jason: batch=2 p95=55ms throughput=420 tokens/s. batch=4 p95=68ms throughput=800 tokens/s. noticed tail variance at batch=4 (spikes ~120ms) — likely refill jitter on CPU worker. flamegraph: https://ci.redwood/bench/venator/2764301123/flame.svg
lynn: try toggling prefix_cache for interactive vs throughput. For throughput runs, disable prefetching and set batch_rate_limit=0.85 in the serving config to reduce refill spikes. Also try `pad_to_multiple_of: 16` as an experiment if kernels accept it.
sudeep: quick CR ping to @infra-team: kernel build that respects pad alignment (w/ opt memmove) would help. Also can we get NVTX traces for the p95 spikes?
infra-team: noted, scheduling kernel rebuild with pad-alignment fixes tonight (ETA 04:00 UTC). We can also enable NVTX on bench nodes for the next runs.
mari: ok holding final catalog entry until kernel rebuild and tokenizer patch. For now marking the draft catalog entry with: `not_ready: true` and a note (tokenizer newline mapping + pad alignment).
jason: quick Q — should we also run q5b quantized variant? I only tested q4.
lynn: yes run q5b; might give better peak throughput but validate model quality on the eval set. Recommend eval_size=2000 prompts for perplexity/response-quality check.
mari: perfect. I'll update the onboarding PR with these notes and tag reviewers. Will re-run bench after infra confirms kernel build. :thumbsup:
sudeep: +1 — I'll prepare NVTX-enabled run configs and a short script to collate p95/throughput across batches.
jason: ping me when kernels land, I'll re-run and upload consolidated CSV.
mari: thanks everyone, closing loop for now.
